does: Looks a text key up in a FixedString-to-eoc::spell::Condition map (0x18-byte values) and gives the value's address and a not-found flag; the AI uses it on its action's roll-condition map.

evidence.says: hashes the FixedString R8 points to, walks the buckets, returns map+0x30 plus index times 0x18, else the flag
in a goblin's turn its six calls take the spell's default text key, and the address it gives is the condition the scorer passes to the chance
